agent.problem: This blanks out the unseen wording of verse 17. The preceding cards describe judgment on the nations but give no context for the turn to Zion's restoration, so the baker cannot reason out 'deliverance' rather than 'destruction' or 'darkness'; they can only guess the next word of the prophetic line.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
